panels.title: Include plugin's .mcp.json (override ignore rule)
panels.scene: A shiny glowing scroll labeled '.mcp.json' buried under a giant pile of mud labeled '.gitignore'. Knight digs it up with a small hand trowel. Villagers are falling to their knees, blinded by its beauty.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: THE HOLY SCROLL! HE RESCUED IT FROM THE DARK VOID OF IGNORE!

bubbles.speaker: Knight
bubbles.text: The main rule was hiding it. I stopped hiding it.

panels.title: Add ChatGPT plugin package v1.0.0
panels.scene: Knight drops a gigantic glowing wooden crate labeled 'ChatGPT Plugin v1.0.0' right into the village square. Dust flies everywhere and a tiny goblin gets squished under it. Villagers scream in total shock and joy.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: A BRAND NEW SPELL PACKAGE FROM THE HEAVENS! VERSION ONE IS HERE!

bubbles.speaker: Other villager
bubbles.text: OUR VILLAGE IS NOW A SMART APP!

bubbles.speaker: Knight
bubbles.text: It's just the files we submitted.

panels.title: Serve OpenAI domain verification token
panels.scene: A massive giant floating eye in the sky labeled 'OpenAI'. Knight stands on a wooden tower holding up a tiny paper ticket with 'token_123' written on it. The giant eye beams down a light of approval.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: THE SKY MONSTER HAS APPROVED OUR KINGDOM! WE ARE LEGITIMATE!

bubbles.speaker: Knight
bubbles.text: It literally just checks one route.

panels.title: 3 commits. 1 app launched. 1 giant eye satisfied.
panels.scene: Knight sitting tired on a wooden bench taking off his helmet. In the background, villagers are carving a giant stone eye and erecting a wooden shrine around a curly brace '{ }'.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: I shall name my newborn child Json-Token!
